11.t: Working with data: conservation of mass
q: What happened to the mass in the sealed flask?
Calculate the mass change in the open beaker.
Explain why the open beaker lost mass.
Carbon dioxide gas escaped into the air.
Explain how the results support the law of conservation of mass.
When nothing can escape the total mass is unchanged: atoms are rearranged, not created or destroyed; the "lost" mass in the beaker is the gas that left.
